name: Konva
role: Canvas 2D scene graph (stage, layers, groups, shapes) with events, tweens and export
summary: Canvas library organised as stage, layers, groups and shapes, with pointer events, per-frame animation, built-in tweens and export of a node or stage to canvas, data URL or Blob at a chosen pixel ratio. Official integrations for React, Vue, Svelte and Angular. Output is canvas pixels. Its strength is a dependency-free, interactive scene graph that suits editor-style UIs.
use_when: Interactive canvas editor or annotation surface with drag, transform and layers
Over Fabric.js when you want a leaner scene graph with React or Vue bindings
Exporting a node or stage at a chosen pixel ratio from script
Over PixiJS when the scene is small and vector-first, not sprite-heavy
avoid_when: Thousands of sprites or shader filters: PixiJS
Seekable timeline motion: GSAP over Konva tweens
notes: 2026-10-26: konvajs.org did not mention Node.js server-side use; not verified.

assessment.rationale: GitHub release 10.9.0 on 2026-10-15; MIT, maintained since 2015. Complements Fabric.js and PixiJS: scene-graph interactivity without SVG round-trip or GPU focus.
